definition.@EndUserText.label: View 1
definition.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT 
    b."BATCH_ID",
    CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP () AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
    'HIST_RAW' AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
    o."SOURCE_FILE",
    "d"."BUKRS",
    CAST("d"."BELNR" AS VARCHAR(10)) AS BELNR,
    CAST("d"."GJAHR" AS VARCHAR(4)) AS GJAHR,
    "d"."BLART","d"."BLDAT","d"."BUDAT","d"."MONAT","d"."CPUDT","d"."CPUTM","d"."AEDAT","d"."UPDDT","d"."WWERT","d"."USNAM","d"."TCODE","d"."BVORG","d"."XBLNR","d"."DBBLG","d"."STBLG","d"."STJAH","d"."BKTXT","d"."WAERS","d"."KURSF","d"."KZWRS","d"."KZKRS","d"."BSTAT","d"."XNETB","d"."FRATH","d"."XRUEB","d"."GLVOR","d"."GRPID","d"."DOKID","d"."ARCID","d"."IBLAR","d"."AWTYP","d"."AWKEY","d"."FIKRS","d"."HWAER","d"."HWAE2","d"."HWAE3","d"."KURS2","d"."KURS3","d"."BASW2","d"."BASW3","d"."UMRD2","d"."UMRD3","d"."XSTOV","d"."STODT","d"."XMWST","d"."CURT2","d"."CURT3","d"."KUTY2","d"."KUTY3","d"."XSNET","d"."AUSBK","d"."XUSVR","d"."DUEFL","d"."AWSYS","d"."TXKRS","d"."LOTKZ","d"."XWVOF","d"."STGRD","d"."PPNAM","d"."BRNCH","d"."NUMPG","d"."ADISC","d"."XREF1_HD","d"."XREF2_HD","d"."XREVERSAL","d"."REINDAT","d"."RLDNR","d"."LDGRP","d"."PROPMANO","d"."XBLNR_ALT","d"."VATDATE","d"."DOCCAT","d"."XSPLIT","d"."CASH_ALLOC","d"."FOLLOW_ON","d"."XREORG","d"."SUBSET","d"."KURST","d"."KURSX","d"."KUR2X","d"."KUR3X","d"."XMCA","d"."/SAPF15/STATUS","d"."PSOTY","d"."PSOAK","d"."PSOKS","d"."PSOSG","d"."PSOFN","d"."INTFORM","d"."INTDATE","d"."PSOBT","d"."PSOZL","d"."PSODT","d"."PSOTM","d"."FM_UMART","d"."CCINS","d"."CCNUM","d"."SSBLK","d"."BATCH","d"."SNAME","d"."SAMPLED","d"."EXCLUDE_FLAG","d"."BLIND","d"."OFFSET_STATUS","d"."OFFSET_REFER_DAT","d"."PENRC","d"."KNUMV"
FROM "1_INBOUND_HIST_RAW.1LT_BKPF_HIST_RAW" d
	CROSS JOIN "2SV_ACTIVE_BATCH_HIST_RAW_01" b
	JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" o 
	    ON o."BATCH_ID" = b."BATCH_ID" 
	        AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'HIST_RAW' 
	        AND o."OBJECT_NAME" = 'BKPF'
